person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and narrates Jake, Josie, Stuart, and other characters in the third person, sometimes entering their thoughts. Distributed Goodreads passages corroborate the authorized third-person excerpt, while two independent whole-book guides explicitly identify the same structure. First-person forms in q05129 and q05134 belong to dialogue or gnomic material, and the “you” in q05127 is direct address; none indicates an alternate base section. The official excerpt has limited scope, but the whole-book descriptions and multiple interior quote contexts leave no material unresolved conflict.
